title: A component document, as the engine answers it (Component)

name.description: a bench shared by name — i2c-bus —, or null

duration.description: seconds it runs, or null where its expectation's measure says

temperature.description: the temperature it runs at, kelvin, or null for the nominal bench

realistic.description: whether its instruments load what they read and a part fails as its component says

parts.description: the parts it adds round the part tried: sources, loads, instruments

Bench.description: What a part is tried among: a bench's parts, how long it runs, at what temperature, and whether it is realistic — its instruments load what they read, a part fails as its component says.

pin.description: the pin it names; null when the part is connected in pin order

net.description: the net the pin is on

Connection.description: One connection of a part: the pin it names — none when the part is connected in pin order — and the net.

value.description: the value — or the row of values — the measure must be
the value the measure is held near

tolerance.description: how far from it the measure may be: 5%, 2 mV

anyOf.description: the values the measure may take
the values the measure may take

slug.description: what the document is known by: its address among the library's

title.description: what it is called, for a reader

type.description: the role its kind gives it — type gate —, or null where it says none

meta.description: its meta fields — summary, source, category … —, as written

DocumentHead.description: What every document of the model says of itself: its slug, its title, the role its kind gives it (type gate), and its meta fields — summary, source, category… — as written.

uses.description: the drawings it may be drawn with, the first its default; empty for a box

box.description: the sides of the box it is drawn as, or empty for a drawing it uses

bindings.description: what the drawing's inputs are, from the part's values and pins

Drawing.description: How a component is drawn — its symbol — or how it looks — its portrait —: the drawings it uses, by slug, or a box of its own, and what the drawing's inputs are bound to.

anyOf.description: the value it is given, or null for a pin
the value it is given, or null for a pin

pin.description: the part's pin it follows, or null for a value

Drawing.Binding.description: failed = failed, a anode: an input of the drawing, given a value or one of the part's pins.

marks.description: how it is marked: edge, bubble

Drawing.BoxPin.description: A pin on a box's side, and its marks — edge, bubble.

side.description: the box's side: left, right, top or bottom

pins.description: the pins drawn there, in order

Drawing.BoxSide.description: A side of a box and the pins it draws there, each with its marks: left clock edge, cs bubble.

from.description: the pin or node it runs from

to.description: the pin or node it runs to

value.description: what the current or voltage is, for jMF

Equation.Branch.description: current base -> bi = …, voltage out -> 0 = …: a branch through the part, from one pin or node to another.

statement.description: the whole line as written: one statement of jMF

Equation.Defined.description: left = right, both sides as written for jMF: a definition (delay_scale(supply) = …), a value (temperature = ambient + heating), a next or a start value (x_next = …). statement is the whole line as written: one statement of jMF, as jMF reads a definition.

rate.description: how fast it changes, for jMF

Equation.Derivative.description: d(flux)/dt = primary - secondary: how fast a state changes. A document writes it as any other Defined line; it is a derivative because jMF reads its left side as one, where it is compiled.

name.description: the name it gives the value

type.description: the quantity it is — voltage, ratio —, or null

Equation.Local.description: let V_be : voltage = …: a name for a value the other equations use.

title.description: what it says holds, for a reader

source.description: why it holds — a datasheet's line, a calculation —, or empty

bench.description: the bench it runs on when it is not the document's own, or null

anyOf.description: what the measure is held to
what the measure is held to
what the measure is held to

Expectation.description: What a document says it does, to be checked by running it: what holds, why — its source —, on which bench, measured how, held to what.

index.description: a figure for each slot of a row — cell[32] —, or null for one

anyOf.description: how it is computed from the part's nets and states
how it is computed from the part's nets and states

unit.description: what it is shown in — %, °C —, or null for a bare number

signal.description: whether an instrument's reading is a signal to plot, rather than a number to show

caption.description: what it says of itself; empty when not written

Figure.description: A figure a component shows — display — or an instrument reads — measure —: a value computed from the part's nets and states, the unit it is shown in, and a caption.

written.description: the expression as its author wrote it

Formula.description: An expression as its author wrote it — 4.7 kΩ, 100 * abs(anode.current) / I_maximum —, for jMF to compile where it is computed. The model says what it is for; what it means is the formula language's.

Index.description: The index a name is written with: a bus's bits — q[0..7] —, or a row's slots — memory[256], slots 0 to 255. Each of them is a name of its own, the name and its number joined: q_0, memory_255.

name.description: what it is called, as the equations name it

description.description: what it is, for a reader

InternalNode.description: A node of a component's own, behind its pins — the intrinsic base of a transistor —, and what it is.

pin.description: the instrument's pin it is wired to

stripes.description: its stripes' colour, or null for a plain lead

Lead.description: The lead an instrument's pin is wired with: its colour, and its stripes' colour, or null.

statistic.description: what is taken of the reading: final, maximum, average, frequency …

subject.description: the net or expression it reads, or null where it reads something else

reading.description: what else it reads — current, level, levels, figure, figures —, or null for a subject

targets.description: what that reading names: a part, a net, a part's figures

conditions.description: each condition's word and its value in SI: after, above, below, at

settings.description: the settings changed for this measure alone

Measure.description: What an expectation measures: a statistic — final, maximum, average, frequency… — of a subject — a net, current R1, out - in —, and when: after 60 ms, above 2.5 V, at 1 kHz, with settings changed for it.

name.description: what it is called, as formulas name it

anyOf.description: its value: a formula, or a text
its value: a formula, or a text
the values it may take, or null for any
the values it may take, or null for any

step.description: how far one step of a control moves it, or null

per.description: the unit it is counted per — V per unit —, or null

flags.description: how it is offered, as written: log, integer, exact, animate, live

description.description: what it is, for a reader; empty when not written

Parameter.description: A parameter of a component or a circuit: its name, its value, and what a reader may set it to — a range, a step, a unit it is counted per, and how it is offered (log, integer, live…).

reference.description: what the circuit calls it — R1 —, unique in the circuit

component.description: the component it is, by slug — resistor, lm358@3 for a unit of one

connections.description: what each of its pins is connected to, in pin order or by pin

settings.description: what its parameters are set to

symbol.description: the symbol it is drawn with when not its component's own, or null

footprint.description: the footprint it sits on when not its component's own, or null

pads.description: which pin each pad of that footprint takes, by pad, where this part's differ from what its component says: a footprint another product numbers its own way — a KiCad diode's pad 1 is its cathode. Empty otherwise.

Part.description: A part of a circuit: its reference, the component it is — resistor, lm358@3 for a unit of one —, what it is connected to, what it is set to, and how it is drawn or seated when not as its component says. ⚠️ Every part is a component. A resistor and a microcontroller are the same kind of thing here; which of them the engine solves natively is the engine's to say, from the component, never a second sort of part.

name.description: what it is called, as the part's wires name it

index.description: a bus's bits — q[0..7] —, each a pin of its own; null for one pin

direction.description: input, output, bidirectional, or null for an analog pin that is neither

drive.description: how it drives — open-drain, open-collector (Drive) —, or null for a push-pull output and any other pin

numbers.description: its numbers on the package, in groups as written: 1 7 one group, 15, 1, 2 three — a bus's pins are its groups, one a bit

edge.description: whether it acts on an edge rather than a level: a clock

label.description: what it is, for a reader; empty when not written

Pin.description: A pin of a component: its name, what it carries, which way its signal goes, how it drives, the numbers it has on the package, and a label for a reader.

Range.Between.description: low .. high: every value from one end to the other.

Range.Listed.description: The list as written, brackets and all, for jMF to read.

pads.description: which pin each pad is, by pad, in the order written; empty for the pins' own numbers

Seat.description: A footprint a component sits on, by slug, and which of its pins each pad is when the package numbers them its own way — 1 base —; empty when the pads are the pins' own numbers. The pads keep the order they are written in, so whatever is made of them — a netlist, a pcb file — reads the same every time.

name.description: the parameter it sets, or the word that stands alone

anyOf.description: what it is set to: a formula, or a text
what it is set to: a formula, or a text

Setting.description: A name a part is set by — resistance = R, bytes = "8 0" —, or one standing alone, closed.

name.description: what it is called, as the equations name it

index.description: a row's slots — memory[256] —, or null for one state

anyOf.description: what it holds at the start
what it holds at the start

kind.description: discrete: it changes in steps; continuous: the solver integrates it

anyOf.description: the values it may hold, or null for any
the values it may hold, or null for any

description.description: what it is, for a reader; empty when not written

State.description: A state a component keeps between steps: its start, whether it changes in steps (discrete) or as a quantity the solver integrates (continuous), what it may hold. A name with an index — memory[256] — is a row of them.

text.description: what it says, without its quotes

Text.description: A text a name is given — operation = "write" —: what it says, without its quotes.

head.description: what the document says of itself: its slug, its title, its role and its meta fields

bases.description: the components it extends, by slug — a datasheet part extends the model it is a member of

uses.description: the families and libraries of functions it uses, by slug

units.description: the blocks of its package — units A, B —, each with its own pin numbers and states; empty for a package of one

parameters.description: its parameters, which its equations and behaviour read

nodes.description: the nodes of its own behind its pins

display.description: the figures it shows on a sheet

readings.description: the figures an instrument reads of it

equations.description: its equations for jMF, by their forms

formulas.description: its own definitions for jMF — formulas { … } —, before the libraries it uses add theirs

behaviour.description: its jMS, as written, or null for a component its equations say all of

symbol.description: how it is drawn, or null for a component drawn as its base is

portrait.description: how it looks in the hand, or null

seats.description: the footprints it sits on, the first its own

types.description: the quantity types it names itself — type transconductance = current / voltage ^ 2 —, as written

bench.description: the bench its expectations run on when they name none, or null

expectations.description: what it is expected to do on a bench, each to be checked by running it

leads.description: the leads an instrument's pins are wired with

parts.description: what it is made of, when it is a subcircuit — its own parts, wired to its pins and nets of its own —; empty for a component its equations or behaviour say all of

description: A component: what a part is. Its parameters and pins, the nodes and states of its own, its equations for jMF and its behaviour for jMS, the figures it shows and an instrument reads, how it is drawn, how it looks, what it sits on, and what it is expected to do on a bench.
